must_contain: any form of on-call rotation are not part of this agreement
will not migrate, restructure, or otherwise alter the operational database

messages.body: Read-only creds for the ops database are in your inbox from IT. Anything else blocking you?
Got them, connected fine. I'll have the shipment table loading nightly by end of the month.
One thing the ops leads asked about — dwell time is currently calculated from the gate-in scan. Should be from the gate-out scan. Can that be changed?
Yes, that's just the definition in the transform. I'll fix it in 3 days.
Our biggest shipper keeps asking for visibility into their own loads. Could we give them a login to see just their shipments? Would save us a lot of phone calls.
Let me think about what that involves and come back to you.
Dwell time now uses gate-out. Pushed this morning, numbers look right against the manual spot check.
Confirmed on our side too, thanks. Separate question — the pipeline died Saturday night and nobody noticed until Monday. Can you get paged when that happens?
I'll add a failure alert into the run. I'll get to it when I get a chance.
Small one — can the carrier cost dashboard show cost per mile as well as cost per shipment? Same data, just another column.
Also, while you're in there — our ops database has grown to the point it's slow. Could you restructure the shipments table and add some indexes? You know it better than anyone here now.
I'll send over the handover documentation next Tuesday so you have it well before we wrap.
Any word on the nightly load? You'd said end of July and we're building the ops review around it.
Team is out Thursday and Friday for the carrier conference, so don't expect quick replies.
Where did we land on the shipper login? They asked again on our call this morning and I'd like to give them an answer.
Nightly load is live and has run clean four nights running. Docs are still coming.
